# HysteresisLoopControl

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Exploiting the bistable region of an explosive transition to maintain a network state even after the driving parameter is reversed. Enables memory-like persistence in iNEST architectures, allowing topology to store information without continuous power.
